shortDescription: Billionaire Todd Boehly secured the backing of the US government and Gulf power brokers with ties to the Trump family to bid for Russian oil giant Lukoil's RUS:LKOH international assets, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday.Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
